adminsOnly.title: Admins only
adminsOnly.body: Managing beta testers requires the admin role.

title: Beta testers
intro: Track who you've invited to test the app, see when they sign up, and grant premium so they can try paid features.

add.title: Add a tester
add.body: Records who you invited. Send the actual app invite in TestFlight / Play Console — this list tracks whether they've signed up and lets you grant premium.
add.name: Name (optional)

roster.title: Testers
roster.empty: No testers yet. Add one above.

howTo.title: How beta invites actually work
howTo.body: This list is a tracker. To give someone the app: add them in TestFlight (iOS) or Play Console (Android) — the store emails them the build. When they open the app and sign up, they turn signed up here and you can grant premium so they test paid features.
